title: too-far-future date scenario converted to {MOVE_IN_DATE} (a valid +90d date) — can never trigger the validation_error it asserts
evidence:
expected_outcome: validation_error
expected_error_fields:
  - desired_move_in_date
 ...
  desired_move_in_date: "{MOVE_IN_DATE}" — and SKILL.md:279: "Only the boundary-validation scenarios (`desired-move-in-date-in-past`, `-too-far-future`) pin literal dates on purpose." — and application_handler.gleam: "///   - candidate > today + 12mo → \"pick a date within the next year\"" / "order.Gt -> Error(\"Pick a date within the next year.\")"
detail: {MOVE_IN_DATE} is today+90d, comfortably inside the server's 12-month ceiling, so the submission is fully valid and lands on confirmation. The scenario deterministically fails and the upper-bound branch of validate_move_in_date loses its pin. The in-past twin correctly kept its literal date.
recommended_fix: Restore a literal far-future date (e.g. 2030-01-01) in this scenario, keeping the description's yearly-maintenance note; leave {MOVE_IN_DATE} to non-boundary scenarios per SKILL.md.

title: listing-source-tamper still asserts a field-listing_source-error span that F4 removed from the render
evidence:
expected_outcome: validation_error
expected_error_fields:
  - listing_source — and SKILL.md:206: "`validation_error` → `[data-testid="error-summary"]` visible AND each `expected_error_fields:` entry has its `field-{name}-error` span populated"
detail: F4 removed the listing_source select from work_income.gleam; grep of server/src finds no field-listing_source id or error span anywhere, so the error re-render shows only the error-summary row. The scenario's expected_error_fields assertion can never pass — the rework updated the tamper hook but not the outcome surface.
recommended_fix: Drop listing_source from expected_error_fields and assert the error-summary row (data-testid=error-summary-link) contains the listing_source label/message instead.

title: Stepper preflight-hold traps the applicant when the oversized file sits in an upload slot hidden by the employment-status toggle
detail: Upload an oversized employer_ref_primary, then switch employment_status to student: the toggle hides the slot without clearing its File, evaluate() keeps counting it, so data-preflight-blocked persists. onContinue then holds on documents forever and scrollIntoView targets an inline error inside the hidden wrapper — no visible reason, no in-form recovery.
recommended_fix: Clear uploadInput.value when the employment toggle hides a slot (mirroring clearInputsWithin), or scope preflight evaluate()/the hold to visible file inputs so hidden slots can't block advance.
